A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SKEL-CF. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated material.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction results, component ablations, qualitative comparisons, and camera-factorization analysis in Tables 1–4 and the appendix.

after.justification: v4 retains these original results and adds a fitted CameraHMR comparison and quantitative refinement ablations.

M1.justification: The encoder–decoder architecture, camera integration, SKEL-fitting adaptation, and training losses remain the same. v4 explicitly describes residual updates and frozen pretrained camera weights, but these disclosures do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Evaluation coverage is retained, including MOYO-HARD, COCO, and the appendix's LSP-ext examples. v4 explicitly excludes AVA from the refined training annotations; v1 already uses CameraHMR-refined annotations and does not establish AVA's inclusion, so an actual coverage removal is not demonstrated.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds CameraHMR + SKEL fit alongside the existing HMR2.0 + SKEL fit and HSMR comparators. This is distinct from the unfitted CameraHMR already evaluated in v1. Comparator membership in Tables 2 and 3 is unchanged.

E3.justification: New Appendix Table S1 introduces controlled configurations comparing Lrefine with full Lskel supervision and six distinct decoder layers with one layer repeated six times. Existing metrics, MOYO-HARD sampling, and the main training settings remain unchanged; the implementation settings move to Appendix S3.

E4.justification: v4 adds a targeted refinement study on 3DPW, MOYO, and MOYO-HARD, testing sparse versus full supervision and distinct versus repeated decoder layers. The existing component ablation, camera-factorization analysis, attention visualizations, and qualitative refinement examples are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added experiments continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: New CameraHMR + SKEL fit results include MOYO MPJPE/PA-MPJPE of 75.5/49.9, versus the retained SKEL-CF result of 85.0/51.4. Table S1 adds variant results, including MOYO-HARD PA-MPJPE of 65.2 for full prediction and 70.1 for the repeated layer, versus 61.5 for SKEL-CF. Inference timings are also added. Tables 2–4 and the original camera-factorization results are numerically unchanged.

T1.justification: The parameter definitions and loss equations are mathematically unchanged. Reordering the first three equations and labeling their supervision components adds explanation, without new assumptions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about coarse-to-fine SKEL recovery, 4DHuman-SKEL, camera modeling, accuracy, and anatomical fidelity. Rephrasing the abstract's biomechanics motivation does not materially change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 adds an accuracy/runtime interpretation of fitting-based methods and qualifies the comparison by distinguishing end-to-end approaches. Section 4.4 newly attributes the existing 53.7 versus 79.6 PA-MPJPE gap to annotation quality; this is an interpretation of existing scores. Section 3.2 also explains the computational motivation for pose-only auxiliary supervision.

D1.justification: v4 newly specifies camera-weight freezing, AVA exclusion, conversion of 3M images in approximately 58 hours on an RTX 3090, and inference timings. It shortens the explicit upper-limb/full-body fitting schedule to a generic hierarchical description. Existing optimizer, architecture, and training-budget details are retained in Appendix S3; video-access instructions now point to the project page.

R1.justification: v4 adds Deformable DETR and explicitly acknowledges DETR-style coarse-to-fine refinement and auxiliary supervision. It removes the detailed discussion of CameraHMR's CLIFF features and HSMR's Skelify strategy, while retaining those methods elsewhere. The overall research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: The loss exposition is reorganized into clearer supervision and refinement paragraphs, implementation details move to the appendix, and appendix sections are reordered. Local wording, terminology, author-name, and affiliation edits accompany these changes; the main narrative and section sequence remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains two-stage/end-to-end groupings and MOYO-HARD columns, while removing percentage annotations. v4 adds Table S1 and relocates existing appendix figures and the camera-factorization table. The qualitative illustrations remain the same, but their raster resolution is substantially reduced, making zoomed details less sharp.

improvement.justification: The stronger fitted CameraHMR comparator makes the evaluation more informative, and the new refinement ablations directly support design choices previously supported less specifically. Clearer implementation disclosures and attribution also help. These are incremental gains, partly offset by reduced figure detail and the shortened fitting-procedure description; the principal method and existing benchmark results remain unchanged.
